explanation: The plant is native to China. New Zealand growers, who built its export trade, renamed it after their national bird, and they renamed the tree tomato the tamarillo too.

claims.text: Kiwifruit was commonly sold in English as Chinese gooseberry before New Zealand exporters renamed it kiwifruit.
Cape gooseberry is another fruit (physalis), and tree tomato was the old name of the tamarillo, so neither was the old name of kiwifruit.
The kiwifruit plant is native to China.
New Zealand growers renamed the fruit kiwifruit, after the kiwi, New Zealand's national bird.
New Zealand growers also renamed the tree tomato, calling it the tamarillo.
